item.tib: drag po gshed brdungs gi las ling ga bris gyer
item.note: the term gshed refers to the possibility for the soul of a deceased person to be captured by evil spirits soon after death has occurred; these spirits are said to capture the soul and keep it 'imprisoned' for an indeterminate period of time, so that she cannot proceed through the intermediate state and obtain another rebirth according to her karmic inclinations, no matter whether good or bad. the ritual called gshed bkral has the function of preventing such an obstacle; it is performed for the first time on the third day of death — since it is believed that only after three days is an individual 'completely' dead — and once a week for the following seven weeks.
